passages.text: Now Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured Ai and devoted it to destruction —doing to Ai and its king as he had done to Jericho and its king—and that the people of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were living near them.
passages.sermon:
Adoni-zedek was king of Jerusalem.
He heard news about Joshua.
Joshua had captured the city of Ai.
Joshua destroyed Ai and its king.
Joshua did to Ai and its king what he had done to Jericho and its king.
Adoni-zedek also heard about the people of Gibeon.
The people of Gibeon had made peace with Israel.
The people of Gibeon were living near the Israelites.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ אֲדֹֽנִי־ צֶ֜דֶק מֶ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם כִּֽי־ לָכַ֨ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ אֶת־ הָעַי֮ וַיַּחֲרִימָהּ֒ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה לִֽירִיחוֹ֙ וּלְמַלְכָּ֔הּ כֵּן־ עָשָׂ֥ה לָעַ֖י וּלְמַלְכָּ֑הּ וְכִ֨י הִשְׁלִ֜ימוּ יֹשְׁבֵ֤י גִבְעוֹן֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּֽהְי֖וּ בְּקִרְבָּֽם׃

passages.text: So Adoni-zedek and his people were greatly alarmed, because Gibeon was a great city, like one of the royal cities; it was larger than Ai, and all its men were mighty.
passages.sermon:
Adoni-zedek was the king of Jerusalem.
His people lived with him.
They heard news about Gibeon.
Gibeon was a great city.
Gibeon was like one of the royal cities.
Gibeon was larger than Ai.
All the men of Gibeon were mighty.
Adoni-zedek and his people became very afraid.
passages.original: וַיִּֽירְא֣וּ מְאֹ֔ד כִּ֣י עִ֤יר גְּדוֹלָה֙ גִּבְע֔וֹן כְּאַחַ֖ת עָרֵ֣י הַמַּמְלָכָ֑ה וְכִ֨י הִ֤יא גְדוֹלָה֙ מִן־ הָעַ֔י וְכָל־ אֲנָשֶׁ֖יהָ גִּבֹּרִֽים׃

passages.text: Therefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent word to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish, and Debir king of Eglon, saying, “Come up and help me. We will attack Gibeon, because they have made peace with Joshua and the Israelites.”
passages.sermon:
Adoni-zedek was king of Jerusalem.
He sent a message to four other kings.
He sent to Hoham, king of Hebron.
He sent to Piram, king of Jarmuth.
He sent to Japhia, king of Lachish.
He sent to Debir, king of Eglon.
He said, “Come up to me and help me.
We will attack Gibeon.
Gibeon made peace with Joshua and the Israelites.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח אֲדֹנִי־ צֶ֜דֶק מֶ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֶל־ הוֹהָ֣ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ חֶ֠בְרוֹן וְאֶל־ פִּרְאָ֨ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ יַרְמ֜וּת וְאֶל־ יָפִ֧יעַ מֶֽלֶךְ־ לָכִ֛ישׁ וְאֶל־ דְּבִ֥יר מֶֽלֶךְ־ עֶגְל֖וֹן לֵאמֹֽר׃ עֲלֽוּ־ אֵלַ֣י וְעִזְרֻ֔נִי וְנַכֶּ֖ה אֶת־ גִּבְע֑וֹן כִּֽי־ הִשְׁלִ֥ימָה אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וְאֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: So the five kings of the Amorites—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon—joined forces and advanced with all their armies. They camped before Gibeon and made war against it.
passages.sermon:
Five kings ruled over the Amorites.
These kings were the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
These five kings gathered together.
They brought all their armies with them.
They marched to Gibeon.
They set up camp near Gibeon.
They attacked Gibeon.
passages.original: וַיֵּאָסְפ֨וּ וַֽיַּעֲל֜וּ חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת׀ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֗י מֶ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ חֶבְר֤וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ־ יַרְמוּת֙ מֶֽלֶךְ־ לָכִ֣ישׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ עֶגְל֔וֹן הֵ֖ם וְכָל־ מַֽחֲנֵיהֶ֑ם וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ עַל־ גִּבְע֔וֹן וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עָלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: Then the men of Gibeon sent word to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal: “Do not abandon your servants. Come quickly and save us! Help us, because all the kings of the Amorites from the hill country have joined forces against us.”
passages.sermon:
The men of Gibeon sent a message to Joshua.
Joshua was in the camp at Gilgal.
The men of Gibeon said, “Do not abandon your servants.
Come up to us quickly.
Save us.
Help us.
All the kings of the Amorites who live in the hill country have gathered against us.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלְח֣וּ אַנְשֵׁי֩ גִבְע֨וֹן אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה֙ הַגִּלְגָּ֣לָה לֵאמֹ֔ר אַל־ תֶּ֥רֶף יָדֶ֖יךָ מֵֽעֲבָדֶ֑יךָ עֲלֵ֧ה אֵלֵ֣ינוּ מְהֵרָ֗ה וְהוֹשִׁ֤יעָה לָּ֙נוּ֙ וְעָזְרֵ֔נוּ כִּ֚י נִקְבְּצ֣וּ אֵלֵ֔ינוּ כָּל־ מַלְכֵ֥י הָאֱמֹרִ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָהָֽר׃

passages.text: So Joshua and his whole army, including all the mighty men of valor, came from Gilgal.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel’s army.
He was at Gilgal.
Joshua left Gilgal.
He brought his whole army with him.
All the fighting men came with Joshua.
All the mighty warriors came too.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַל יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ מִן־ הַגִּלְגָּ֗ל ה֚וּא וְכָל־ עַ֤ם הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וְכֹ֖ל גִּבּוֹרֵ֥י הֶחָֽיִל׃פ

passages.text: The LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, for I have delivered them into your hand. Not one of them shall stand against you.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Joshua.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said, “Do not be afraid of them.”
The LORD said, “I have given them into your hand.”
The LORD said, “None of them will be able to stand before you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ אַל־ תִּירָ֣א מֵהֶ֔ם כִּ֥י בְיָדְךָ֖ נְתַתִּ֑ים לֹֽא־ יַעֲמֹ֥ד אִ֛ישׁ מֵהֶ֖ם בְּפָנֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: After marching all night from Gilgal, Joshua caught them by surprise.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel’s army.
He marched all night from Gilgal.
He brought his army with him.
Joshua reached the enemy suddenly.
He caught them by surprise.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֧א אֲלֵיהֶ֛ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ פִּתְאֹ֑ם כָּל־ הַלַּ֕יְלָה עָלָ֖ה מִן־ הַגִּלְגָּֽל׃

passages.text: And the LORD threw them into confusion before Israel, who defeated them in a great slaughter at Gibeon, pursued them along the ascent to Beth-horon, and struck them down as far as Azekah and Makkedah.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acted for Israel.
The LORD confused Israel’s enemies.
Israel fought their enemies at Gibeon.
Israel defeated their enemies with a great blow at Gibeon.
Israel chased their enemies along the road that goes up to Beth-horon.
Israel struck down their enemies as far as Azekah.
Israel struck down their enemies as far as Makkedah.
passages.original: וַיְהֻמֵּ֤ם יְהוָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּכֵּ֥ם מַכָּֽה־ גְדוֹלָ֖ה בְּגִבְע֑וֹן וַֽיִּרְדְּפֵ֗ם דֶּ֚רֶךְ מַעֲלֵ֣ה בֵית־ חוֹרֹ֔ן וַיַּכֵּ֥ם עַד־ עֲזֵקָ֖ה וְעַד־ מַקֵּדָֽה׃

passages.text: As they fled before Israel along the descent from Beth-horon to Azekah, the LORD cast down on them large hailstones from the sky, and more of them were killed by the hailstones than by the swords of the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
The LORD fought for Israel.
The enemies of Israel ran away.
They ran down the slope from Beth-horon toward Azekah.
The LORD threw large hailstones down from the sky onto them.
The hailstones fell until they reached Azekah.
Many of the enemies died from the hailstones.
More enemies died from the hailstones than from the swords of the Israelites.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֞י בְּנֻסָ֣ם׀ מִפְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הֵ֞ם בְּמוֹרַ֤ד בֵּית־ חוֹרֹן֙ וַֽיהוָ֡ה הִשְׁלִ֣יךְ עֲלֵיהֶם֩ אֲבָנִ֨ים גְּדֹל֧וֹת מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם עַד־ עֲזֵקָ֖ה וַיָּמֻ֑תוּ רַבִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁר־ מֵ֙תוּ֙ בְּאַבְנֵ֣י הַבָּרָ֔ד מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָרְג֛וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּחָֽרֶב׃ס

passages.text: On the day that the LORD gave the Amorites over to the Israelites, Joshua spoke to the LORD in the presence of Israel: “O sun, stand still over Gibeon, O moon, over the Valley of Aijalon.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
The LORD fought for Israel.
The LORD gave the Amorites to Israel.
This happened on a special day.
On that day, Joshua spoke to the LORD.
All Israel saw Joshua speak.
Joshua said, "Sun, stand still over Gibeon."
Joshua also said, "Moon, stand still over the Valley of Aijalon."
passages.original: אָ֣ז יְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה בְּי֗וֹם תֵּ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ לְעֵינֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שֶׁ֚מֶשׁ בְּגִבְע֣וֹן דּ֔וֹם וְיָרֵ֖חַ בְּעֵ֥מֶק אַיָּלֽוֹן׃

passages.text: So the sun stood still and the moon stopped until the nation took vengeance upon its enemies. Is this not written in the Book of Jashar? “So the sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.”
passages.sermon:
God fought for Israel on this day.
The sun stood still in the sky.
The moon stopped moving.
This happened until Israel defeated its enemies.
The Book of Jashar records this event.
The sun remained in the middle of the sky.
The sun did not hurry to set.
The day lasted about a full day.
passages.original: וַיִּדֹּ֨ם הַשֶּׁ֜מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֣חַ עָמָ֗ד עַד־ יִקֹּ֥ם גּוֹי֙ אֹֽיְבָ֔יו הֲלֹא־ הִ֥יא כְתוּבָ֖ה עַל־ סֵ֣פֶר הַיָּשָׁ֑ר וַיַּעֲמֹ֤ד הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ בַּחֲצִ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְלֹא־ אָ֥ץ לָב֖וֹא כְּי֥וֹם תָּמִֽים׃

passages.text: There has been no day like it before or since, when the LORD listened to the voice of a man, because the LORD fought for Israel.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD listened to the voice of a man on that day.
No day like that had ever happened before.
No day like that has happened since.
The LORD fought for Israel.
passages.original: וְלֹ֨א הָיָ֜ה כַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ לְפָנָ֣יו וְאַחֲרָ֔יו לִשְׁמֹ֥עַ יְהוָ֖ה בְּק֣וֹל אִ֑ישׁ כִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה נִלְחָ֖ם לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
All the people of Israel followed Joshua.
Joshua and all Israel returned together.
They went back to their camp.
Their camp was at Gilgal.
passages.original: וַיָּ֤שָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עִמּ֔וֹ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה הַגִּלְגָּֽלָה׃

passages.text: Now the five kings had fled and hidden in the cave at Makkedah.
passages.sermon: Five kings fled.\r\nThey hid in a cave.\r\nThe cave was at Makkedah.
passages.original: וַיָּנֻ֕סוּ חֲמֵ֖שֶׁת הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַיֵּחָבְא֥וּ בַמְּעָרָ֖ה בְּמַקֵּדָֽה׃

passages.text: And Joshua was informed: “The five kings have been found; they are hiding in the cave at Makkedah.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Someone told Joshua important news.
They said, “We have found the five kings.”
The five kings are hiding.
They are hiding in a cave.
The cave is at Makkedah.
passages.original: וַיֻּגַּ֖ד לִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ לֵאמֹ֑ר נִמְצְאוּ֙ חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת הַמְּלָכִ֔ים נֶחְבְּאִ֥ים בַּמְּעָרָ֖ה בְּמַקֵּדָֽה׃

passages.text: So Joshua said, “Roll large stones against the mouth of the cave, and post men there to guard them.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua spoke to his people.
He gave them a command.
He said, “Roll large stones against the mouth of the cave.”
He also said, “Appoint men to stand there.”
He told them, “Let these men guard the cave.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ גֹּ֛לּוּ אֲבָנִ֥ים גְּדֹל֖וֹת אֶל־ פִּ֣י הַמְּעָרָ֑ה וְהַפְקִ֧ידוּ עָלֶ֛יהָ אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לְשָׁמְרָֽם׃

passages.text: But you, do not stop there. Pursue your enemies and attack them from behind. Do not let them reach their cities, for the LORD your God has delivered them into your hand.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua spoke to the people.
He said, “Do not stop here.
Chase your enemies.
Attack them from behind.
Do not let your enemies reach their cities.
The LORD your God has given your enemies into your hand.”
passages.original: וְאַתֶּם֙ אַֽל־ תַּעֲמֹ֔דוּ רִדְפוּ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י אֹֽיְבֵיכֶ֔ם וְזִנַּבְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתָ֑ם אַֽל־ תִּתְּנ֗וּם לָבוֹא֙ אֶל־ עָ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם כִּ֧י נְתָנָ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם בְּיֶדְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: So Joshua and the Israelites continued to inflict a terrible slaughter until they had finished them off, and the remaining survivors retreated to the fortified cities.
passages.sermon:
Joshua led the Israelites in battle.
Joshua and the Israelites attacked their enemies.
They struck their enemies with a very great blow.
They continued fighting until they finished off their enemies.
Some of the enemy survived.
The survivors escaped.
The survivors went into the fortified cities.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ כְּכַלּ֨וֹת יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְהַכּוֹתָ֛ם מַכָּ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה־ מְאֹ֖ד עַד־ תֻּמָּ֑ם וְהַשְּׂרִידִים֙ שָׂרְד֣וּ מֵהֶ֔ם וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־ עָרֵ֥י הַמִּבְצָֽר׃

passages.text: The whole army returned safely to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah, and no one dared to utter a word against the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
Joshua led the Israelites.
The whole army returned to the camp.
The camp was at Makkedah.
They returned safely to Joshua.
No one spoke against the Israelites.
No one dared to challenge them.
passages.original: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ֩ כָל־ הָעָ֨ם אֶל־ הַמַּחֲנֶ֧ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ מַקֵּדָ֖ה בְּשָׁל֑וֹם לֹֽא־ חָרַ֞ץ לִבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לְאִ֖ישׁ אֶת־ לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then Joshua said, “Open the mouth of the cave and bring those five kings out to me.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of the Israelites.
Joshua spoke to his men.
He gave them a command.
He said, “Open the entrance of the cave.”
He said, “Bring the five kings out of the cave to me.”
The five kings were hiding in the cave.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ פִּתְח֖וּ אֶת־ פִּ֣י הַמְּעָרָ֑ה וְהוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֵלַ֗י אֶת־ חֲמֵ֛שֶׁת הַמְּלָכִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִן־ הַמְּעָרָֽה׃

passages.text: So they brought the five kings out of the cave—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites obeyed Joshua.
They opened the cave.
They brought out five kings.
These kings were enemies of Israel.
They brought out the king of Jerusalem.
They brought out the king of Hebron.
They brought out the king of Jarmuth.
They brought out the king of Lachish.
They brought out the king of Eglon.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עֲשׂוּ כֵ֔ן וַיֹּצִ֣יאוּ אֵלָ֗יו אֶת־ חֲמֵ֛שֶׁת הַמְּלָכִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִן־ הַמְּעָרָ֑ה אֵ֣ת׀ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֶת־ מֶ֤לֶךְ חֶבְרוֹן֙ אֶת־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יַרְמ֔וּת אֶת־ מֶ֥לֶךְ לָכִ֖ישׁ אֶת־ מֶ֥לֶךְ עֶגְלֽוֹן׃

passages.text: When they had brought the kings to Joshua, he summoned all the men of Israel and said to the army commanders who had accompanied him, “Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings.” So the commanders came forward and put their feet on their necks.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
They brought the five enemy kings to Joshua.
Joshua called all the men of Israel.
Joshua spoke to the commanders of the army.
These commanders had fought with him.
Joshua said, “Come here.”
He said, “Put your feet on the necks of these kings.”
The commanders came forward.
They put their feet on the necks of the kings.
passages.original: וַ֠יְהִי כְּֽהוֹצִיאָ֞ם אֶת־ הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵלֶּה֮ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֒ וַיִּקְרָ֨א יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל־ כָּל־ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַ֠יֹּאמֶר אֶל־ קְצִינֵ֞י אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ הֶהָלְכ֣וּא אִתּ֔וֹ קִרְב֗וּ שִׂ֚ימוּ אֶת־ רַגְלֵיכֶ֔ם עַֽל־ צַוְּארֵ֖י הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַֽיִּקְרְב֔וּ וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ אֶת־ רַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ צַוְּארֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: “Do not be afraid or discouraged,” Joshua said. “Be strong and courageous, for the LORD will do this to all the enemies you fight.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua spoke to the people of Israel.
Joshua said, “Do not be afraid.
Do not be discouraged.
Be strong.
Be courageous.
The LORD will do this to all your enemies.
You will fight these enemies.
The LORD will defeat them.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ אַל־ תִּֽירְא֖וּ וְאַל־ תֵּחָ֑תּוּ חִזְק֣וּ וְאִמְצ֔וּ כִּ֣י כָ֗כָה יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְכָל־ אֹ֣יְבֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם נִלְחָמִ֥ים אוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: After this, Joshua struck down and killed the kings, and he hung their bodies on five trees and left them there until evening.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua struck down the kings.
Joshua killed the kings.
Joshua hung their bodies on five trees.
Their bodies remained on the trees until evening.
passages.original: וַיַּכֵּ֨ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵן֙ וַיְמִיתֵ֔ם וַיִּתְלֵ֕ם עַ֖ל חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה עֵצִ֑ים וַיִּֽהְי֛וּ תְּלוּיִ֥ם עַל־ הָעֵצִ֖ים עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: At sunset Joshua ordered that they be taken down from the trees and thrown into the cave in which they had hidden. Then large stones were placed against the mouth of the cave, and the stones are there to this day.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
At sunset, Joshua gave an order.
He told his men to take the bodies down from the trees.
They threw the bodies into the cave.
This was the same cave where the kings had hidden.
They placed large stones at the mouth of the cave.
The stones are still there today.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֞י לְעֵ֣ת׀ בּ֣וֹא הַשֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ צִוָּ֤ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ וַיֹּֽרִידוּם֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָעֵצִ֔ים וַיַּ֨שְׁלִכֻ֔ם אֶל־ הַמְּעָרָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֶחְבְּאוּ־ שָׁ֑ם וַיָּשִׂ֜מוּ אֲבָנִ֤ים גְּדֹלוֹת֙ עַל־ פִּ֣י הַמְּעָרָ֔ה עַד־ עֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ

passages.text: On that day Joshua captured Makkedah and put it to the sword, along with its king. He devoted to destruction everyone in the city, leaving no survivors. So he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
On that day, Joshua captured the city of Makkedah.
He struck the city with the sword.
He killed the king of Makkedah.
He destroyed every person in the city.
He left no survivors in Makkedah.
Joshua treated the king of Makkedah the same way he treated the king of Jericho.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ מַקֵּדָה֩ לָכַ֨ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא וַיַּכֶּ֣הָ לְפִי־ חֶרֶב֮ וְאֶת־ מַלְכָּהּ֒ הֶחֱרִ֣ם אוֹתָ֗ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַנֶּ֙פֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֔הּ לֹ֥א הִשְׁאִ֖יר שָׂרִ֑יד וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ מַקֵּדָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְמֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיחֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Makkedah to Libnah and fought against Libnah.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
All Israel was with Joshua.
Joshua and all Israel left Makkedah.
They went to Libnah.
Joshua and all Israel fought against Libnah.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֣ר יְ֠הוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָֽל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֛וֹ מִמַּקֵּדָ֖ה לִבְנָ֑ה וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם עִם־ לִבְנָֽה׃

passages.text: And the LORD also delivered that city and its king into the hand of Israel, and Joshua put all the people to the sword, leaving no survivors. And he did to the king of Libnah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave the city of Libnah to Israel.
The LORD also gave the king of Libnah to Israel.
Joshua attacked the city with the sword.
Joshua killed everyone in Libnah.
Joshua left no survivors in Libnah.
Joshua treated the king of Libnah as he had treated the king of Jericho.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּן֩ יְהוָ֨ה גַּם־ אוֹתָ֜הּ בְּיַ֣ד יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל וְאֶת־ מַלְכָּהּ֒ וַיַּכֶּ֣הָ לְפִי־ חֶ֗רֶב וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַנֶּ֙פֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֔הּ לֹֽא־ הִשְׁאִ֥יר בָּ֖הּ שָׂרִ֑יד וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לְמַלְכָּ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְמֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיחֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: And Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish. They laid siege to it and fought against it.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
All the people of Israel were with Joshua.
Joshua and all Israel left the city of Libnah.
They traveled to the city of Lachish.
Joshua and Israel set up camp near Lachish.
They attacked the city of Lachish.
They fought against the people of Lachish.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֣ר יְ֠הוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֛וֹ מִלִּבְנָ֖ה לָכִ֑ישָׁה וַיִּ֣חַן עָלֶ֔יהָ וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם בָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, and Joshua captured it on the second day. He put all the people to the sword, just as he had done to Libnah.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave Lachish to Israel.
Joshua led Israel.
Joshua captured Lachish on the second day.
Joshua killed all the people in Lachish with the sword.
Joshua did to Lachish as he had done to Libnah.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶת־ לָכִ֜ישׁ בְּיַ֣ד יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַֽיִּלְכְּדָהּ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וַיַּכֶּ֣הָ לְפִי־ חֶ֔רֶב וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֑הּ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה לְלִבְנָֽה׃פ

passages.text: At that time Horam king of Gezer went to help Lachish, but Joshua struck him down along with his people, leaving no survivors.
passages.sermon:
Horam was the king of Gezer.
He went to help the city of Lachish.
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua attacked Horam.
Joshua attacked all of Horam’s people.
Joshua left no survivors among them.
passages.original: אָ֣ז עָלָ֗ה הֹרָם֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ גֶּ֔זֶר לַעְזֹ֖ר אֶת־ לָכִ֑ישׁ וַיַּכֵּ֤הוּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ וְאֶת־ עַמּ֔וֹ עַד־ בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־ ל֖וֹ שָׂרִֽיד׃

passages.text: So Joshua moved on from Lachish to Eglon, and all Israel with him. They laid siege to it and fought against it.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
All Israel was with Joshua.
Joshua and all Israel left Lachish.
They went to Eglon.
They camped near Eglon.
They fought against Eglon.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֣ר יְ֠הוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֛וֹ מִלָּכִ֖ישׁ עֶגְלֹ֑נָה וַיַּחֲנ֣וּ עָלֶ֔יהָ וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עָלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: That day they captured Eglon and put it to the sword, and Joshua devoted to destruction everyone in the city, just as he had done to Lachish.
passages.sermon:
Joshua led Israel.
They attacked Eglon that day.
They captured the city.
They struck Eglon with the sword.
They killed everyone in the city.
Joshua devoted all the people in Eglon to destruction.
He did the same thing to Eglon as he had done to Lachish.
passages.original: וַֽיִּלְכְּד֜וּהָ בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ וַיַּכּ֣וּהָ לְפִי־ חֶ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ הַנֶּ֣פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֔הּ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא הֶחֱרִ֑ים כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה לְלָכִֽישׁ׃פ

passages.text: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron and fought against it.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
All Israel was with Joshua.
They left Eglon.
They went up to Hebron.
They fought against Hebron.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַל יְ֠הוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָֽל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֛וֹ מֵעֶגְל֖וֹנָה חֶבְר֑וֹנָה וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עָלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: They captured it and put to the sword its king, all its villages, and all the people. Joshua left no survivors, just as he had done at Eglon; he devoted to destruction Hebron and everyone in it.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua and the Israelites captured Hebron.
They killed the king of Hebron with the sword.
They killed all the villages of Hebron.
They killed all the people in Hebron.
Joshua left no survivors in Hebron.
Joshua did the same thing at Hebron as he had done at Eglon.
Joshua devoted Hebron and everyone in it to destruction.
passages.original: וַיִּלְכְּד֣וּהָ וַיַּכּֽוּהָ־ לְפִי־ חֶ֠רֶב וְאֶת־ מַלְכָּ֨הּ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ עָרֶ֜יהָ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַנֶּ֤פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּהּ֙ לֹֽא־ הִשְׁאִ֣יר שָׂרִ֔יד כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה לְעֶגְל֑וֹן וַיַּחֲרֵ֣ם אוֹתָ֔הּ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: Finally Joshua and all Israel with him turned toward Debir and fought against it.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
All Israel was with Joshua.
Joshua and all Israel turned toward Debir.
They fought against Debir.
passages.original: וַיָּ֧שָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֖וֹ דְּבִ֑רָה וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם עָלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: And they captured Debir, its king, and all its villages. They put them to the sword and devoted to destruction everyone in the city, leaving no survivors. Joshua did to Debir and its king as he had done to Hebron and as he had done to Libnah and its king.
passages.sermon:
Joshua led Israel.
Joshua captured Debir.
Joshua captured the king of Debir.
Joshua captured all the villages of Debir.
Joshua and Israel struck them with the sword.
They destroyed every person in Debir.
They left no survivors in Debir.
Joshua did to Debir and its king what he had done to Hebron.
Joshua did to Debir and its king what he had done to Libnah and its king.
passages.original: וַֽיִּלְכְּדָ֞הּ וְאֶת־ מַלְכָּ֤הּ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ עָרֶ֙יהָ֙ וַיַּכּ֣וּם לְפִי־ חֶ֔רֶב וַֽיַּחֲרִ֙ימוּ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ נֶ֣פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֔הּ לֹ֥א הִשְׁאִ֖יר שָׂרִ֑יד כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה לְחֶבְר֗וֹן כֵּן־ עָשָׂ֤ה לִדְבִ֙רָה֙ וּלְמַלְכָּ֔הּ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לְלִבְנָ֖ה וּלְמַלְכָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: So Joshua conquered the whole region—the hill country, the Negev, the foothills, and the slopes, together with all their kings—leaving no survivors. He devoted to destruction everything that breathed, just as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded.
passages.sermon:
Joshua led Israel.
Joshua attacked the whole region.
He conquered the hill country.
He conquered the Negev.
He conquered the foothills.
He conquered the slopes.
He defeated all the kings in these places.
He left no survivors.
He destroyed everything that breathed.
He did this because the LORD, the God of Israel, commanded him.
passages.original: וַיַּכֶּ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֡רֶץ הָהָר֩ וְהַנֶּ֨גֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָ֜ה וְהָאֲשֵׁד֗וֹת וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ מַלְכֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א הִשְׁאִ֖יר שָׂרִ֑יד וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ הַנְּשָׁמָה֙ הֶחֱרִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ה יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Joshua conquered the area from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, and the whole region of Goshen as far as Gibeon.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua conquered land.
He took the area from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza.
He also took all the land of Goshen.
He conquered as far as Gibeon.
passages.original: וַיַּכֵּ֧ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ מִקָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ וְעַד־ עַזָּ֑ה וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֶ֥רֶץ גֹּ֖שֶׁן וְעַד־ גִּבְעֽוֹן׃

passages.text: And because the LORD, the God of Israel, fought for Israel, Joshua captured all these kings and their land in one campaign.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD fought for Israel.
Joshua captured all these kings.
Joshua took all their land.
Joshua did this in one campaign.
passages.original: וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ הַמְּלָכִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ וְאֶת־ אַרְצָ֔ם לָכַ֥ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת כִּ֗י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נִלְחָ֖ם לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
All the people of Israel were with Joshua.
Joshua and all Israel returned together.
They went back to their camp.
Their camp was at Gilgal.
passages.original: וַיָּ֤שָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עִמּ֔וֹ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה הַגִּלְגָּֽלָה׃פ
